description: The Stakeholder Influence Map shows everyone involved in a decision on one record – for example the buying committee on an opportunity, the key people on an account, or the stakeholders of a project or grant. For each person you record their influence (1 to 5) and their stance (from Opponent to Champion). The control places them in a four-part matrix so the team can see at a glance who to win over, who to lean on and who simply needs to be kept informed.
features: Power-support matrix (Manage closely, Leverage, Monitor, Keep informed)
Add/edit/delete stakeholders with influence, stance, role
Coverage score and relationship insights (missing decision roles, high-influence opponents, stale contacts, single-threading)
Keyboard and touch operable, phone layout
